aiMetadata.description: Logs a new time entry (timesheet record) in Kimai for a given project and activity, with a required begin time and optional end time and description. Use when an agent needs to record tracked work against a Kimai project. Each call appends a new timesheet, so it is not idempotent; repeating it creates duplicate entries.
